recap: Jarrett Allen led the Cavaliers with 24 points (9-13 FG), 16 rebounds and 2 assists.
LaMelo Ball led the Hornets with 30 points (12-22 FG, 0-2 3PT), 7 rebounds and 6 assists.
CLE won 4 of 4 factors: shooting, ball security, second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 43.3 to 41.2.
Biggest swing: LaMelo Ball personal foul (Q4 14.9), +11 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Rubio, Allen, Markkanen, Garland, Mobley, +6 in 5:43.
Bench points: CLE 20, CHA 36. Points in the paint: 54–50. Second-chance points: 24–21.
